title: MobileInject: Evaluating Reasoning-to-Action Security of MLLM-Based Mobile Agents under Cross-Modal Consistency Injection
abstract: arXiv:2610.23307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based mobile agents are rapidly evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that perceive, reason over, and act on smartphone environments. This capability also exposes a new security risk: adversaries can embed malicious objectives in cross-application mobile content and steer agent behavior through indirect multimodal injection. Although prompt injection has been studied in desktop and web settings, its cross-modal properties in mobile ecosystems remain poorly understood, and existing security analyses are still limited. To close this gap, we introduce MobileInject, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile agents against multimodal injection attacks and reasoning-to-action security risks. MobileInject provides a high-fidelity interactive mobile evaluation framework covering 11 scenarios, 9 security-risk categories, and 108 executable risk instances. It further introduces Cro

translated_title: MobileInject：评估基于多模态大语言模型的移动智能体在跨模态一致性注入下的“推理到行动”安全性
translated_abstract: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的移动智能体正迅速从对话式助手演变为能够在智能手机环境中进行感知、推理并采取行动的自主系统。这种能力同时也带来了新的安全风险：攻击者可以在跨应用的移动内容中嵌入恶意目标，并通过间接多模态注入来操纵智能体的行为。尽管提示注入攻击已在桌面端和网页环境中得到研究，但其在移动生态系统中的跨模态特性仍然鲜为人知，现有的安全分析也依然有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 MobileInject，这是首个用于评估移动智能体抵御多模态注入攻击及“推理到行动”安全风险的基准。MobileInject 提供了一个高保真的交互式移动评估框架，涵盖 11 种场景、9 类安全风险和 108 个可执行的风险实例。它还进一步引入了跨模态……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个针对移动智能体的多模态注入攻击安全基准 MobileInject，通过涵盖 11 种场景、9 类安全风险和 108 个可执行风险实例的高保真交互式框架，系统评估了基于多模态大语言模型的移动智能体在跨模态一致性注入下从“推理”到“行动”的安全风险。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MobileInject, the first benchmark for evaluating MLLM-based mobile agents against multimodal injection attacks and reasoning-to-action security risks, featuring a high-fidelity interactive framework with 11 scenarios, 9 security-risk categories, and 108 executable risk instances.
